verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a developer-first public API with both REST and GraphQL endpoints. The API includes auto-generated per-workspace documentation, an interactive playground, a Metadata API for schema changes, batching up to 60 records, role-scoped API keys and webhooks, and custom objects get identical endpoints automatically. A community user independently reports the REST API 'worked ok'. Missing for 10: no static public OpenAPI spec at standard docs paths (the probe returned 404, so the spec appears to be per-workspace only).
